author: maria
body: Typo: 'recieved' should be 'received' in the comment above this block.

author: dev-oskar
body: If the order is already shipped you need to throw here — we can't let cancellation go through on a shipped order. Should be `throw new AppError('ORDER_ALREADY_SHIPPED')`.

author: lena
body: Use `clock.now()` here instead of `Date.now()`. The whole point of injecting the clock is so tests can freeze time — `Date.now()` breaks that.

author: maria
body: We're calling `audit.log(...)` but that method doesn't exist. The module only exposes `audit.record(eventName, data)`. This will blow up at runtime.

author: dev-oskar
body: Be careful with rounding on partial refunds — floating point here can bite you.

author: lena
body: Refunds have to go through `payments.refund(order.paymentRef, amountCents)`. Don't touch `total_cents` directly — invoicing reads that field and any mutation will corrupt the invoice.

author: maria
body: `clock.now()` please, not `Date.now()`. We've had this conversation before — see PR #14.

author: dev-oskar
body: Same issue as PR #13 — you cannot cancel a shipped order. The guard should be at the top of this function: check status, throw `AppError('ORDER_ALREADY_SHIPPED')` immediately.

author: lena
body: Still using `audit.log` — this doesn't exist. Switch to `audit.record('order.cancelled', { orderId: order.id })`. Event names are `order.<verb>` and data must include `orderId`.

author: maria
body: Rename `tmp` to `pendingItems` — `tmp` tells me nothing about what this holds.

author: dev-oskar
body: To be precise on the rounding: use `Math.floor`, never `Math.round`. Even 1 cent over-refund is a real-money error that will cause reconciliation failures.

author: lena
body: You're zeroing out `total_cents` again. Don't do this — invoicing reads it directly. Issue the refund via `payments.refund(order.paymentRef, amountCents)` and leave `total_cents` alone.

author: maria
body: `audit.record` takes `(eventName, data)` where data must have `orderId`. Something like `audit.record('order.refunded', { orderId: order.id, amountCents })`. There's no `audit.log`.

author: dev-oskar
body: Shipped orders are final. Any attempt to modify or cancel must throw `AppError('ORDER_ALREADY_SHIPPED')` — we've reverted this twice already, please add a test to lock it in.
